data.summary:
**When:** Any phase.

**Target:** An **ENDLESS MULTITUDE** unit of yours that was just **destroyed**. The Stratagem can target it even so.

**Effect:** Add to your army a new unit, identical to the **destroyed** one and at its full [Starting Strength](vsdata:core-rule/units-and-models), placed in [Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves).

**Restrictions:** Any **CHARACTER** units that had been attached to the unit, and were **destroyed**, do not come back. This Stratagem can be used only once per battle.
